column1: # Cumulative optimization ladder — GENERATED by benchmarks/scripts/ablation.py
# rung 0 has every ablatable optimization off; each rung adds one back.
# wall_s, peak_rss_kb and every s_* are medians over the repeats; paf_sha is
# identical on every row by construction (the run fails otherwise).
# s_indexing and s_mapping are WALL; every other s_* is CPU summed across
# workers and will exceed the wall at -@N. Never divide one by the other.
# measured with the run-time switches from archive/ablation-instrumentation, which is never
# merged: the shipped mapper carries no ablation code. See manifest.json.
